tools.name: calculate_schengen_days
tools.description: Use this when the user needs a schengen calculator, schengen days left, schengen overstay dates or a 90/180 rule calculator for past and planned short stays. Returns days used and left on the check date, stay compliance, overstay dates and daily CSV. Accepts ISO or English US text dates, up to 60 st

tools.name: plan_schengen_trip
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many days can I stay in Europe, wants a schengen visa calculator or needs to plan 90 days in 180 days. Finds the maximum consecutive short stay from an entry date and the first entry that supports a requested length. Past stays must be closed and end by entry; up to 6

tools.name: find_schengen_reset_dates
tools.description: Use this when the user wants schengen days left to return, a schengen 90 day rule projection or a days in Europe calculator for future availability. Projects window headroom on the next 180 dates with a daily CSV, assuming no further stays and departure by the reference date. Up to 60 stays over 1,1
